title: Turn off Apple Intelligence on macOS 27 and get its disk space back
titleZh: Turn off Apple Intelligence on macOS 27 and get its disk space back
author: privacyisntdead
relevanceReason: 命中 3 个 AI/科技关键词。
summaryRaw: Debloat macOS. Turn off Apple Intelligence and delete its models, stop the analytics and ads, quiet the pop-ups, switch off other apps' background updaters and get disk space back. You see every change before it happens, and every change can be undone.

Built on pared by 4evy, who did the hard work first: mapping Apple's asset service, the model sets and the settings keys the Apple Intelligence part relies on. The Verge, Ars Technica, The Register, MacRumors, AppleInsider and Help Net Security have written about RemoveMacAI, and Daring Fireball linked to it. Install The app Open Terminal (Applications > Utilities), paste this line and press Return: curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/omlahore/RemoveMacAI/main/install.sh | bash -s app It downloads the latest release, checks its SHA-256 checksum, puts RemoveMacAI in Applications and opens it. To download it yourself instead, get RemoveMacAI.zip from the latest release, unzip it and drag RemoveMacAI to Applications. The app is not notarized, so the first time you open it macOS says it can't verify it. Open System Settings > Privacy & Security, scroll down and click Open Anyway. The command line curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/omlahore/RemoveMacAI/main/install.sh | bash This runs the command-line version from a temporary folder and installs nothing. With Homebrew: brew install omlahore/tap/removemacai The app and the command line are the same program and share the same undo history. What it does
Section What you can turn off or change

Apple Intelligence Siri, Writing Tools, Genmoji, Image Playground, ChatGPT, summaries in Mail, Messages, Safari, Notes and notifications, inline predictions, Spatial Photos, Photos Clean Up, Xcode predictive completion. The models are deleted and blocked from downloading again. Keep any feature you use.

children.author: antfarm
children.textRawHtml: In Xcode, go to Window > Devices and Simulators in the menu bar (or press Shift+Cmd+2), then select the Simulators tab in the sidebar to open the list of simulators. Here you can select and delete simulators.
